'''Gonk's Infinite Loop''' was the name given to a yard in the [[Attis Station]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Quesh war]], it was patrolled by a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] belonging to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] that had gone rogue and attacked anything in sight.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gonk's Infinite Loop appears as a Heroic area on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. It is the location of the planet's world boss, the Rogue Cartel Warbot.<ref name="TOR" />
